title: Quasi-Abelian uniformization of projective klt varieties from semistable reflexive cotangent equality or nef normalized cotangent sheaves
difficulty_reason: H3: the old local equal-splitting Proposition4.1 supplies only isolated cyclic quotient singularities and does not yield a global Abelian cover. The author global proof first derives minimality by comparing reflexive Chern classes in simply connected extremal-contraction neighborhoods, excludes general type by the incompatible Q-Chern slopes, and combines solvable monodromy filtrations with Shafarevich and Albanese fibre analysis to prove abundance. The further level-three Abelian-group-scheme construction, descent of its moduli map across rationally chain connected fibres, and conversion of the birational group scheme to an isomorphism complete a substantial singular uniformization argument. The normalized-nef criterion is retained as a second author route to the same global outcome, with its original Rossi/negativity/descent argument and separate dimension-two Q-Chern computation. The eight-step proof and its inputs are one coherent H3 unit, beyond standard qualifying work; neither the reused local core nor the supporting special cases receive extra IDs.

editorial_notes: One global H3 uniformization unit, with two distinct original sufficient criteria retained as Theorems1.2 and1.3 and their own proofs. Do not conjoin their hypotheses or split the normalized-nef route into another ID.
Theorem1.2: projective complex klt variety of dimension n>=2, ample H, Omega^[1] H-semistable, and exact Q-Chern equality (n-1)/(2n)*hat-c1^2.H^(n-2)=hat-c2.H^(n-2).
Use Q-Chern classes on the klt variety, not ordinary Chern classes on a resolution. K_X nef/semample is derived inside the proof and is not an added initial assumption.

Theorem1.3: normal projective complex klt n>=2 with (Sym^n Omega_X^1 tensor O_X(-K_X))** nef as a coherent sheaf; initial local freeness, semistability and Q-Chern equality are not assumed. Retain the separate n=2 normalized-symmetric-square calculation.
Quasi-Abelian means a finite surjective quasi-etale cover by an Abelian variety. Do not strengthen the original conclusion to an etale cover or smoothness of the original X.

Full original eight-step argument, Shafarevich/Albanese fibre branches, abundance proposition, solvable projective representation lift, level-three group scheme construction and full normalized proof are supplied as shared source references.

Abundance of X is established with the exact base/fibre hypotheses; the Iitaka fibration is converted through level-three polarized Abelian group schemes and moduli descent to an isomorphism.
Normalized criterion keeps initial coherent-nef rather than locally-free assumption, proves numerical flatness after Rossi/negativity/descent, and handles n=2 separately before invoking1.2.
